**PR 6 of #998: door's six tabs, served branch, poll countdown**

change-route.mjs grows records/sdd tabs over sections it already holds (buildRecordsTab filters snapshot.records newest-first, buildSddTab reads the issue's own snapshot.changes row's artefacts{} map, importing sdd-layout.mjs's LIFECYCLE_STAGES rather than a rival literal per issue #456's drift guard). drawer-model.mjs's TAB_IDS grows to six per design.md: spec, sdd, tasks, workingMemory, reviews, records, each shaped through the existing entry() helper so a failing tab never hides the rest. server.mjs's buildMeta() gains servedBranch (git symbolic-ref --short HEAD on the served root, memoized, sourced to HEAD, a said reason when detached/unreadable). poller.mjs's state() gains intervalMs/nextAttemptAt, armed by scheduleNext() from the injected clock and cleared on pause. lib/banners.mjs's pollIndicator gains an additive countdown field (next poll in N s / paused / polling disabled) beside its unchanged text/paused. app.js wires the served-branch header and the countdown into renderStatus; the door's six tabs needed no new wiring since renderDrawer already looped generically over drawer-model's tabs. Full suite 5679/5680 (session-end-ship's unrelated real-entrypoint failure persists); counted diff 163/400.
